[Spoiler=Finally worldbuild Chimor will][b]Private familiar dinner of Nancenpinko family-2026[/b].
These are simple dinners which happen every weekends in the Nancenpinko family, out of any rituals, and simply a time of food and family, the Sapa, his concubines which he has kids with the cóya and his kids are the ones who are present in these.
Wearing Likapas(wooven sandals) made of guanaco wool by the emperor, while the other adults, the coya and the concubines the sapa had children were using llama wooven likapas, while children were barefoot on the cold polished stone ground towards the place they would eat, the table was shorts just centimeters from the ground, there was no chairs,but instead, blankets colored disposed for the visitors and family to sit, while the sapa had naturally a taller platform to eat, not too much but enough to be noticeable, at the sides, the walls were made of stone covered into fine layers of adobe while textiles with fish patterns and felines were pending from the walls, for ventilation, there was no windows, instead they preferred to use small entrances at the rooftops to make the air circulate and any smoke to pass thought, while illumination would be made by many oil lamps distributed around the room, the servants organized into lines serving the favourite foods of each around the short table, however, roasted maize and cúys were the average to be disposed around.
The sapa, despite not wearing his crown, still showed his status,  wearing a bandanna on his head with the colors of Chimor, Black, Yellow, and Red in squared patterns, his black hairs falling below his shoulders, reaching his shoulder blades beneath a colored blanket with feline and human figures in a orange background, with borders black, his unchu(tunic) was white and sleeveless, made of cotton with a poncho from his shoulders in geometric shapes, colored it is his necklace had kaskete shells pending from it golden base, and his arms would have golden bracelets with strings of colored guanaco wool tied to, his hands having rings made of silver and tumbaga, and one of pure gold with a moonstone on it too, from his waist to below, nothing but a cotton skirt which is hidden by his long tunic to his knees.
The coya would differ herself from the other concubines by wearing gold and jewelry, something the others were limited just to bracelets of tumbaga,the Cóya, Cagén, would have a long single dress colored in dual figures of Chilla, the moon and fish,  with a long piece starting on her shoulders similar to a poncho, but with more silver color and spirals rather zoomorphic forms, her single "dress" would go to her knees, and was made of cotton and colored white with green, below the dress there was also a skirt, she would wear silver earrings similar to those the sapa wears and more necklaces with turquoises and bracelets with aquamarines but still silver, her long hair being decorated with 
The imperial heir, Chay Ullápan wears a identical cloth to his father, but without the earrings or the turban, he differs from his siblings and half siblings as they do not wear the caps he does and he is the only among the kids to wear a likapa on his feet and not being barefoot.
The sapa, naturally sit down on the platform, his wife at his right and the awi(heir) at his left, the rest would sit down whenever they wanted, the servants would then proceed to put each family's member favorite foods, which included:
Roasted duck with kinoa grains.
Chicken stew and white rice.
Barfí(chimú beans) with a Puree of papa(potato) and cherló(sardines)
Soup of kinoa and pumpkin.
Cúy roasted leg with llama ham.
Llama yogurt with honey.
While also many roasted Àmpácilu maize would be found alongside many  Nanprì and Námnáw potatoes, and Cúys distributed around the table. some bowls of water with aromatic herbs would be put side of the foods for the family clean their hands while the drinks would be chicha(alcoholic drink) for the sapa and few concubines, such as the pata Willáy and Ñî Chilla ,  Kamàricho for the coya, the  Ñî Chatay Kùtái Sao Mama Kupamba , the rest, would prefer to drink juices of their favorite fruits.
As they sat on their respective places, would start to eat, no need for any fork or knife, simply usage of hands and the bowls of water to clean, the kids would be the most talkative, and the sapa would then start to speak:
"The wind today is hotter than llama breath."
The family laugh would, the awi thought, would look at his father then question, while ripping off a piece of cuy leg:
"Father father!"He would say as the sapa turned his head to hear"¿Do you know what chimú and a cúy share in common?"
His father nodded with a "no" and the awi, naturally answered:
"¡We eat to the bone and are stubborn to get what we want!"
Not exactly a laugh would follow, but smiles in comprehesion.
In a rather sudden form, the rains started to fall outside, immediately, Mama Kupamba, one of the concubines while cleaning up delicately her fingers, but soon would have her attention and the others to the corridors from a thud on the corridors. She would be the first to speak.
"Oh for the love of the heavens [i]Chìcho[/i]" 
As she said small feet could be heard walking around the corridors, when it finally revealed, a baby llama reveled, she had smelled the food, and tried to snack a little of what fallen into the ground, but one of the concubines would take it away. But the animal showed stubborn and somewhat irritated, she laid on the ground and and refused to leave, what made the empress Cagén to look at the animal and then say in a smile.
"¡Oh, so dramatic you are! She grabbed a piece of roasted duck and then guided it to the animal mouth, which bitten and happily eaten, then approached the sapa for a little cuddle and pat on the ears, which the sapa would joyfully do. And the Ñî Chilla would hold a hand in front of her mouth to restrict her own laughing. "She is more than determined to do things in most dramatic way" she gave a little suggestive ironical glance of seconds to the Ñî Chatay"as some people i know."
One of the kids, Potao Pál looked at the animal with a certain exasperationon her eyes:
"Mama always says llamas are as stubborn as the old men from the Altiplano"She touched the empress, in a somewhat form of making her remember, then she reminisced." Yes yes,¡ I remember as clear as Chatay now! When they rejected the kinoa for their fragile Kamàrikinua."
The Pata Willáy and  Ñî Chatay, Kupamba and Chàmpú respectively, while the others talked about llamas, they would about food, as Chàmpú cleaned her son, Pichún mouth which had little marks of food on his cheek.
"  Ohohoho  my little boy calm down a little. " She asked as picked more water to clean his cheeks " ¡A cuy you eating are and not a whole llama!
Kupamba on the other side would launch a simple answer:
" My lady, know you should boys eat more than girls, ¡look at my little princess Chao!"
She pointed prideful towards her daughter, Ancu Chao who was eating in a far more calmer and delicate way by making small mounds of rice on her hands and  then eat without getting dirty a little, Chàmpú on the otherside gave her a ironic smile.
"Then i suppose i should..."She put her hand on top of her son's head then told him"I suppose i should taught my boy how some good manners."
As the time passed and the rain gave a lesser hotter air to be replaced by a more rain smell and calming atmosphere, the little llama sleeping next to one of the textiles. One of the kids, Ñúllu Nópan got off her blanket then grabbed her father's cloth, then asking:
"¡ Papa, papa!" She said each time repeating in a louder tone to get his attention.
"Yes yes speak my pretty girl."
He gave then all of his attention back to his daughter, who happily asked:
"My orchids we planted on the garden, ¿ will grow will not them?"
The sapa would look up towards the rooftop, then looked back to his daughter answering her question:
"Yes yes, they of course will,will need to put a stake for it grow later as well." He seemed to remember more about the plant drinking the last sip of his chicha."I will ensure we shall take care of it together."
The ñî Chilla gave a funny smile to the Ñî Chatay while drinking her chicha.
"Seems like a botanic in our family we shall have."
The other ñî thought, would give her a ironic laughing.
"Well, this surely is, more useful than certain people in our family."
The sapa then looked to the watch on the other side of the walls, taking a last bite of his maize and cleaning his fingers, this would be the sign everyone do the same as it marked the end of the dinner, all then drinking their juices and drinks as the sapa words echoed:
"I believe the Cóllangada(a annual event of sport of llama racing) will be just in half a hour, hm...Also a new puzzle to complete, a thousand pieces of mountains, a truly...satisfying torture."
And so, naturally they left, needless to say the servants would clean it all up, the emperor picked his wife and son's hand and soon Chìcho would awake and follow the empress in short hazings of her paws.[/Spoiler]

[sub]"FROM HYPERBOREA, ALL THE WAY TO YOU"[/sub]][i]Alas, in the days after that matter, a more courtly statement would come to succeed the Combine's frank proclamation of an independent Hyperborean nation, delivered through the old communications channels once maintained by the Mandate. And yet, within this statement, there would be no renunciation of the former colony's bid at independence, but much rather a further strengthening of the will of Eirian, the Six Republics, and her people. 

[list][sub][b]COMBINE OF EIRIAN
OFFICE OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS
HYPERBOREA, OUTER BELT REGION

TO: THE HIGH COUNCIL OF THE ERENE FEDERATION
FROM: THE PROVISIONAL CONGRESS OF THE SIX REPUBLICS OF EIRIAN
CLASSIFICATION: OPEN DIPLOMATIC TRANSMISSION
DATED 1ST JANUARY, 2168

SUBJECT: RENEWED DECLARATION OF SELF-GOVERNANCE, AND FORMAL NOTICE OF SOVEREIGN STATUS
[/b]
To the honorable stewards of the High Council of the Erene Federation,

In accordance with interstellar law, prior accords of mutual recognition and autonomization, and the longstanding principle that governance derives its truest legitimacy from the consent of the government, the Provisional Congress of the Six Republics of Eirian- formerly the dome-cities of Galuse, Valee, Loum, Dorothy, Ursan, and Orise- hereby issues this official communique to reaffirm, without lasting ambiguity, the sovereign will of its people. 

For sixty-one years, we of Hyperborea have laboured with diligence and loyalty under the charge of the Hyperborean Mandate and the oversight of the Federation. From this icy, barren surface, we have carved out grand cities to call our own, and in that arduous task, have forged a society that has endured countless hardships and isolation with unwavering resolve. 

We acknowledge the historical ties that bind our two peoples together, and we acknowledge the priceless assistance provided to us in our founding years. But we cannot ignore that realities have shaped our present. The instability that has tightly gripped Erene since the wars of the early 22nd century, the subsequent decay of federal capacity, and the withdrawal of effective governance beyond the Belt of Tears have left Hyperborea in the practice of self-administration for over a decade. The dissolution of the Hyperborean Mandate in 2157 marked a conclusion to an imposed structure that no longer serves its purpose, nor commands respect among our populace.

In years since, we, the citizens of this world- those who were born of this planet and choose Hyperborea as their home, not Erene- have forged ourselves an identity distinct, coherent, and unified as the spirit of freedom. Through democratic processes and referenda across the Six Republics, the people have determined that we are no longer to be regarded as another dependency of Erene, but as a self-determining polity.

[b]Accordingly, we reiterate the following terms to you:
- Hereafter, we recognize ourselves as the Combine of Eirian, a sovereign and independent state.
- All administrative, legal, economic, and military functions are officially transferred to the government, which will solely conduct them with the will of the people.
- Previous structures of the Federation-appointed governance are dissolved, and shall not be reinstated henceforth.
-  The Combine of Eirian remains open to diplomatic normalization, trade agreements, transit rights, and other related cooperative frameworks with the Federation based on parity and mutual respect.
- No return to subordinate colonial status shall be considered; any attempt to forcefully subjugate the Combine will be met with hostilities.[/b]

This communique is not an indictment of the Federation, nor is it an act of hostility. It is the natural culmination of circumstances set in motion by history, born of complete necessity, dignity, and maturation of a new people. We express our most earnest hope that relations between our government may proceed peacefully, and under recognition of this reality. Under this expression, we would further like to express our disapproval of the High Council's decision to mandate a cessation of the food trade beyond the belt of tears. We hope this communique will allow the High Council to reconsider its decision and grant an exemption to the Combine in this regard.

The Combine extends its hand not as a subordinate, but as a neighbor.[/sub]

Long Live the Combine, Long Live the Six Republics,

[b]AURIN BRENN [/b]
Interim Speaker of the Provisional Congress
Republic of Eirian, Hyperborea

[b]DR. SEONS MANCAID[/b]
Minister of Interplanetary Affairs

[b]ADM. RHISED MIXTA[/b]
Commander of the Eirian Settlement Defense Force[/list] 

(Erene Federation)

---

Now, given the lingering precarity of the Federation's current embargo on the food trade beyond the Belt of Tears, and the slim chances for the asked respite in the nation's official statement, it would become increasingly evident that further diplomatic wrangling would be necessary to further establish the legitimacy of the Combine. On the same day of the prior communique, the Provisional Congress would approve action by the Ministry of Interplanetary Affairs to further cement Eirian's bid at lasting sovereignty.  

From the Republic of Valee, which maintained the most powerful communications systems among the Six Republics,  several open communiques would be sent across the Ardagan system, with the hope of establishing official diplomatic channels, by which further relations could blossom. Particularly, the following nations/entities received these communiques:

[list]- [nation]-ISCOS-[/nation][/list]

The Combine awaits a response.[/i][/spoiler][/quote]

[b]Official Response from the High Kingdom of Aldarjón[/b]

[i]The High Kingdom of Aldarjón acknowledges receipt of the Combine of Eirian and confirms its willingness to open formal diplomatic channels with the Combine. Aldarjón recognizes the importance of open communication, and the mutual recognition of legitimacy in this era. In this spirit, Aldarjón agrees to the opening of provisional diplomatic channels with the Combine of Eiran.[/i]
